description: [roadmap S2.8] framegate.py marked EVERY checkpoint of a scenario NOT_RUN when the boot stopped without a divergence (sg_run_boot returned an error such as a missing name: bres.first_divergence is None, so `div is None` made every row a bad boot), which is why cov_r_s2_screens' end_of_year .. pre_land stayed NOT_RUN even with the U-1253 KNOWN entry. Fixed in the S2.8 mirror: such a stop sets div to the number of equal records, so the checkpoints before it are judged (8_merge.md item 2)

[roadmap S2.8] which member Sprite::drawAlpha's quarter band calls on the game's display. Its instructions (0x10018f0f..0x1001909a) call thunk 0x100011ea -> draw16_1002ed60 while its flag byte [ebp-0x10] (set to 1 at entry) is non-zero, else thunk 0x1000126c -> draw16_10043430, and clear the flag only when the destination's format word [1] is 1 (0x100189af). On cov_r_s2_screens the dimming equals draw16_1002ed60's 555 arithmetic, floor((P + 3 D) / 4) per channel (99.4 % of the toolbar pixels of rep_comments against the radial_hover reference, 21.9 % with draw16_10043430's 565 masks), so the reference display's format word [1] is not 1. The value of that word is not read directly; roadmap S2.9's gfx_dialogs.cpp models the 565 member
needed: a read of the live display's format words (Surface slot +0xe4) in a run of the original

description: [roadmap S2.8] the hire dialog's four animated employees: each pass calls addSprite (0x240, row y, last y, 0x28, 0x28, cellAt(0x20e + k, frame % sheet size, s), 4, 0x82 + k), which draws a FLIC sheet cell through drawQueuedSprite at once. The backend has no FLIC cells (roadmap S3.4 / S3.5), so the call is reported (`no body: addSprite`) and cov_r_s2_screens `hire` differs in 1,397 judged px, all inside x 556..586, y 167..403 (the four icons and their shadows; pinned in test_gfx_reports.py RESIDUAL)
needed: S3.4 (FLIC sheet cells in the backend) and S3.5 (drawQueuedSprite)

description: [roadmap S2.8] the histograph's event markers: the two 2 x 2 dots and the stem are drawn (fillWindowRect, Widget_fillRect), the text (drawText4049d0 at (x2 + 14, 0x209 - slot - 3), built from the event kind's pieces as the end-of-year highlights, a kind outside the two switch windows keeping the previous event's text) is not: it would be drawn inside the GDI clip region Surface_box selects (jgld Surface::setClip calls SelectClipRgn), which the text provider does not take. The port reports it (`no body: showHistographScreen.eventText`). No pinned checkpoint shows a marker (rep_histograph is in the first game month)
needed: a checkpoint with an event marker and a clip rectangle in TextMetrics::draw_glyphs

description: [roadmap S2.8] the OK button's hover image of the financial report, comments, best scores, histograph and end-of-year screens: the original reads the cursor (View_toLocal) every pass and redraws the button on entering or leaving its box; the port's loops (click_or_key_loop, reports.cpp report_loop) read no cursor, so the hover image is never drawn. Adding the reads changes which recorded cursor reads the run consumes before each dispatch (TraceInput's pump assignment), so it was left. The judged checkpoints all show the normal button (0 px). hole stats, roster, shortcuts and hire read the cursor and draw the hover image
needed: a decision on cursor reads in the report loops, judged by the segment gate

description: [roadmap S2.8] the financial report's port body (phase 3.7b) calls appendNumber for every cell without the original's buf[0] = 0 before each (0x0044f81a, 0x0044f8a9), so g_textBuffer grows by the cells' texts on every showing; after about eight showings in one session it would run past the 0x1000-byte buffer into the objects above it (the hire dialog had that defect, phase 4). Not changed here: the drawing builds each cell under ScreenDraw::text and gives the buffers back
needed: the original's clears in show_financial_report, judged by the segment gate (g_textBuffer is a hidden-class object)
